content:
Hi all,

Happy to share https://github.com/kmehltretter82/foundations-of-computation-lean

Standalone Lean 4 formalization of the Foundations of Computation textbook, not relying on Mathlib. Includes a Verso site.

It covers the book from logic, sets, and induction through automata, grammars, and Turing machines to undecidability, with no Mathlib dependency. Currently more than 500K lines of Lean 4.

This made heavy use of AI coding agents. Now with no sorrys and no axiom declarations. Probably cleanup and improvements will be done in the future.

Happy about any feedback.
